 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At

Nehdai, P.S. Mohangarh, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan Former
Agricultural Officer, Bank Of Baroda, Branch Pokaran
(Lodged In Central Jail, Jaisalmer)

 ----Respondent
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Dinesh Kumar Godara
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Surendra Bishnoi, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Mukesh Rajpurohit
Order 06/12/2025
1 .  The instant application for bail under Section 483 of BNSS (439 of Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in the present matter.
The requisite details of the matter are tabulated herein below:
Particulars of the case  2. Police Station Pokaran  3. District Jaisalmer 4. Offences alleged in the FIR Under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406/120-B of IPC 5.
Offences added, if any Under Sections 218/120 B IPC 2.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is false and fabricated and the offences alleged in this case are triable by the Court of Magistrate.

It is further submitted that the petitioner is an Agriculture Officer in (Uploaded on 06/12/2025 at 02:21:43 PM)

sentences.text: It is also submitted that the petitioner has been in custody since long and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time; therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused- petitioner.

4. Per contra, the learned Public Prosecutor submits that the present petitioner is involved in this case on the ground that based on his pre-inspection report and agriculture sections's loan recommendation, the bank sanctioned the loan to other co- accused, therefore, the benefit of bail may not be granted to the petitioner.

5. Having heard and considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case as well as perused the material available on record; considering the fact that the offences alleged are triable by the Court of Magistrate, the petitioner is in custody since long and the trial will take sufficiently long time to conclude, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
6. Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 of BNSS (439 of Cr.P.C.) is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused- petitioner as named in the cause title, arrested in connection with the above mentioned FIR, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that (Uploaded on 06/12/2025 at 02:21:43 PM)
[2025:RJ-JD:52914] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-14933/2025] court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
7. In addition to the above, the petitioner is directed to appear before the concerned Police Station in the first week of every quarter of the year.
8. It is made clear that if the petitioner indulges in any similar kind of criminal activity, the learned Public Prosecutor shall be free to file an application for cancellation of bail.

(MUKESH RAJPUROHIT),J 24-Ramesh/-
